notes: Directory has no Freeman row. Separate TBD M6 row names Cheryl Register and J145, unlike live vacancy Floater Team/J165; no occupant inferred.
Ojeda and Gravitt fax numbers differ; Bassett and Carpanini assistants differ; Rafool assistant middle initial omitted in directory.
Kohl and Stamey profiles state fax N/A, while directory supplies fax numbers; Flynn directory adds a Bartow fax and J142.
Gerald Hill directory supplies J109 absent from profile. Allison Kaylor directory gives J172 versus profile Drawer 172.

Kohl/Stamey directory includes Bartow drawers J157/J136 and rooms in addition to Lake Alfred physical addresses. Footnote instructs NE Branch mail to 200 Government Center BLVD, Haines City, FL 33844. Preserve as mailing instruction, not a correction to physical location.
Directory assignment labels are often broader than profile labels. Abdoney directory says Felony, while profile says Felony (Capital)/Civil; both retained.
facts.review_scope: All 36 named Polk records matched or marked absent; phone/assistant/fax comparison plus visual address/assignment table screening. No legal authority resolution.
